API ReferenceZscaler Digital Experience APIReportsGets the list of all active geolocations for the time range specified
Gets the list of all active geolocations for the time range specified
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zdx/v1/active_geo

Gets the list of all active geolocations for the time range specified. If not specified, the endpoint defaults to the last 2 hours. The state and city data is retrieved only for the US.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
from
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The start time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

to
integer

Possible values: >= 0

The end time (in seconds) for the query. The value is entered in Unix Epoch. If not entered, returns the data for the last 2 hours.

parent geo id
string

The parent geo ID.

q
string

The search string used to support search by name.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
string

The geolocation ID.

name
string

The name of the parent geolocation.

geo_type
string

The geolocation type.

children
object[]
]
